entry.name: jit.fx.rgb2luma
entry.description: jit.fx.rgb2luma converts a 4-plane char ARGB (alpha, red, green, blue) texture into a 1-plane char monochrome texture containing the luminosity of the original texture using the equation L = (.299 * R value) + (.587 * G value) + (.114 * B value).
